from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


def junit(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
    suite = root if root.tag == "testsuite" else root.find("testsuite")
    if suite is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No testsuite found in {path}")
    return {
        "tests": int(suite.attrib.get("tests", 0)),
        "failures": int(suite.attrib.get("failures", 0)),
        "errors": int(suite.attrib.get("errors", 0)),
        "skipped": int(suite.attrib.get("skipped", 0)),
        "time_seconds": float(suite.attrib.get("time", 0.0)),
    }


def coverage(path: Path) -> float:
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return float(data["totals"]["percent_covered"])


def statuses(path: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    result: dict[str, int] = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        name, value = line.split("\t", 1)
        result[name] = int(value)
    return result


def failure_tails(evidence: Path, gate_status: dict[str, int]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    result: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for name, code in gate_status.items():
        if code == 0:
            continue
        path = evidence / f"{name}.log"
        if path.exists():
            result[name] = path.read_text(
                encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"
            ).splitlines()[-180:]
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--decision", choices=("PASS", "FAIL"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    evidence = args.evidence
    gate_status = statuses(evidence / "status.tsv")

    report: dict[str, Any] = {
        "schema": (
            "aspenops.comprehensive-code-closure-result/v2"
            if args.decision == "PASS"
            else "aspenops.comprehensive-code-closure-blocker/v2"
        ),
        "decision": args.decision,
        "qualified_source_baseline": "60d47ab88324c5998a068768d87c635e50fcceda",
        "hard_gates": gate_status,
        "runtime_control_plane_changed": False,
        "aspen_executed": False,
        "parameter_estimation_executed": False,
        "dynamic_modeling_executed": False,
        "machine_learning_executed": False,
        "qualification_boundary": (
            "Portable Python numerical, orchestration, persistence, IPC and package evidence; "
            "not licensed Aspen solve or engineering certification."
        ),
        "qualification_run": {
            "run_id": os.environ.get("RUN_ID", ""),
            "run_attempt": os.environ.get("RUN_ATTEMPT", ""),
        },
    }

    if args.decision == "FAIL":
        report.update(
            {
                "source_changes_retained": False,
                "failure_tail": failure_tails(evidence, gate_status),
            }
        )
        Path("docs/COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_CLOSURE_BLOCKER.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        return

    benchmark = json.loads((evidence / "benchmark.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    hygiene = json.loads((evidence / "hygiene-audit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    operation_counts = json.loads(
        (evidence / "operation-counts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )
    report.update(
        {
            "benchmark": benchmark,
            "hygiene_audit": hygiene,
            "operation_counts": operation_counts,
            "focused_tests": junit(evidence / "focused-junit.xml"),
            "full_tests": {
                version: junit(evidence / f"junit-{version}.xml")
                for version in ("3.11", "3.12", "3.13")
            },
            "coverage_percent": {
                version: coverage(evidence / f"coverage-{version}.json")
                for version in ("3.11", "3.12", "3.13")
            },
            "issues_fixed": [
                "Cancelled batch results deep-copy mutable diagnostics and violations.",
                "CasePool.close persists sub-threshold cache hit accounting.",
                "Worker diagnostics tolerate a non-object backend worker field.",
                "Worker runtime evidence is deep-isolated from cache identity state.",
                "Queue unfinished-task accounting is removed where join is never used.",
                "Validated result lists return without redundant reconstruction.",
                "Decoded JSON cache objects avoid a redundant top-level mapping copy.",
                "Pending hit rows stream to SQLite without an intermediate list.",
                "Finite constraint violations cannot overflow diagnostics to infinity.",
                "Optimization violation aggregation saturates at the largest finite score.",
                "Weighted objective aggregation preserves cancellation and finite optimizer scores.",
            ],
            "preserved_contracts": [
                "module-level pool.replace observability for existing regression guards",
                "cache-key bytes and public cache_key call observability",
                "result, cancellation and runtime evidence isolation",
                "cache hit totals, LRU and SQLite transaction semantics",
                "worker generation, timeout and recycle semantics",
                "request/result JSON and IPC protocol shapes",
                "constraint, balance, objective and optimizer ordering semantics",
                "licensed Aspen execution remains explicitly gated",
            ],
            "source_files_changed": [
                "src/aspenops_nexus/cache.py",
                "src/aspenops_nexus/evaluation.py",
                "src/aspenops_nexus/optimization.py",
                "src/aspenops_nexus/pool.py",
                "src/aspenops_nexus/worker.py",
                "tests/test_finite_aggregation.py",
                "tests/test_runtime_closure.py",
            ],
            "v1_blocker_resolved": [
                "pool.replace compatibility symbol retained",
                "temporary SQLite connections explicitly closed under Python 3.13",
            ],
            "external_gate": "PENDING_LICENSED_WINDOWS_ASPEN_ENGINEERING_CERTIFICATION",
        }
    )
    Path("docs/COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_CLOSURE_RESULT.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    speedups = benchmark["speedups"]
    Path("docs/COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_CLOSURE_RESULT.md").write_text(
        "# AspenOps Comprehensive Code Closure V2\n\n"
        "**PASS**\n\n"
        "- Eleven reproducible correctness, numerical-integrity and efficiency gaps closed\n"
        f"- Queue drain speedup: {speedups['queue_drain']:.3f}x\n"
        f"- Validated result return speedup: {speedups['validated_return']:.3f}x\n"
        f"- Cache decode speedup: {speedups['cache_decode']:.3f}x\n"
        "- Finite-safe constraint, violation and weighted-objective aggregation: PASS\n"
        "- Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 full qualification: PASS\n"
        "- Static, security, order, operation-count, build and frozen-Wheel gates: PASS\n"
        "- Licensed Windows/Aspen engineering certification: pending\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
